hooks.name: Run the tests for a saved module
hooks.description: After the agent saves src/<module>.py, run tests/test_<module>*.py and put the pytest summary into the agent's context, so a regression shows up in the same turn.

hooks.name: Syntax-check frontend scripts
hooks.description: After the agent saves a file in src/static/js/, check every frontend script with node --check (a broken script leaves the page blank).

hooks.name: Guard git against data, weights and history rewrites
hooks.description: Before any shell command runs, block git add of data/, weights or volume files, git add --force, force pushes and git reset --hard (exit 2 blocks the call).

hooks.name: Claims check at the end of a turn
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, re-run the claims check on README, docs and steering, so an unsourced number or a 'first SAM for seismic' claim is caught before the owner reads it.
